ledger: Diner shell and glazing | exterior entrance between broad windows, truck left of building | interior window wall continues beside booth seating | exterior view establishes a single room; window-facing shots place the parking area beyond the glass

Booths and customer aisle | booths line the left window wall in kitchen-facing views; aisle separates booths from counter stools | same arrangement in the final wide shot | reverse views should place glazing and booths on the opposite screen side without exchanging their physical positions

Main counter | long solid counter on the right, with a rounded foreground return and wood-paneled customer face | same continuous counter separates customer aisle from service area | tabletop and front panel must block lower bodies behind them; crossing between sides requires going around an end

Stool row | stools follow the customer edge of the counter, facing the service wall | row remains beside the same counter edge | seated customers occupy the aisle side; stools remain in front of the counter panel

Kitchen hatch and cooking area | far-wall rectangular hatch reveals a broad stainless extractor hood and cooking equipment | later hatch views again show the hood arrangement | at 00:36 the same opening instead reveals a cabinet-lined preparation area with a blue panel

Service wall | coffee equipment and worktop behind the counter on the right; doorway beside the kitchen hatch | same service strip remains visible at the end | closer kitchen-facing views retain hatch-left/equipment-right ordering

Entrance and reverse sightline | kitchen-facing views look away from the entrance | kitchen-side reverse view shows the entrance and exit sign beyond the counter, with windows to the right | hatch framing occludes the room edges while the counter recedes toward the entrance

People relative to counter | server works on service side; customer approaches along the booth-side aisle and sits | server returns from customer side to service side | ordinary counter occlusion holds in most shots; at 01:52 her body crosses the continuous counter instead of passing around its end

findings.entity: Kitchen background through the service hatch
findings.description: The kitchen-facing wide shot replaces the stainless extractor hood and cooking line visible through the hatch at 00:19–00:27 with tan wall cabinets, a preparation counter, and a blue panel on the left. The hatch, adjacent window, clock, and main counter retain essentially the same viewing alignment, so this is a different fixed kitchen arrangement through the same opening, not a reverse angle. The original hood arrangement is visible again at 00:51.

After rising from a customer-side stool, the server steps right through the continuous rounded counter. During the crossing, the tabletop cuts across her hips while a trousered leg remains visible in front of the solid wooden panel; she then emerges fully in the service aisle by 01:53. The counter remains intact throughout, and she never reaches or passes around its end.
